      What's new

      Season 01
      24 Nov · Season launch

      Season 01: First Tracks is live

      Freshline's first season starts now. Three parks are open: Bluebird Park, Pine Alley and Summit Line, wider than ever and lined with big tables built for corks and flips. Set a best on every park to fill your lift pass, land the daily challenge for a +5,000 bonus, and make your rider yours in the Locker.

      3 parksDay & nightDaily challengesSkis + snowboard

      Dev log · November 2026

      26 Nov · Shop

      New fits: anorak, tee and PJs

      Three new kinds of clothing hit the Item Shop: the Storm Anorak with a hood that goes up over your helmet, a Layered Tee over a long-sleeve undershirt, and plaid PJ Pants in red or flannel blue. Snowboard boots now have proper bindings with straps and a highback, and the Hero Cape hangs and streams without clipping. Contrails are gone, and anyone who bought one got their Flakes back.

      26 Nov · Shop

      Real gear has landed

      The Item Shop now sells actual new gear: four hats (including the Viking Helm), five back blings like the Rocket Pack, Penguin Pal and a Hero Cape that streams out at speed, and five wraps for your skis or board. Tap any item for a full 3D preview, and hit Preview in action to watch it on a jump.

      26 Nov · Feature

      The Item Shop is open

      Spend your Flakes in the new Item Shop, between Ride and the Locker. Featured outfit bundles and daily single items rotate every night at midnight, and bundles are cheaper than buying the pieces one by one. Everything is cosmetic, and anything you buy is yours to wear any time in the Locker.

      26 Nov · Parks

      Three new parks

      Titan Air is the biggest air on the mountain: a steep, fast pitch into giant XXL and MEGA kickers with over ten metres of height and nearly three seconds of hang time. Whoop Woods is a flowy run of snow rollers you can pop off, and Rail Yard is a jib park packed with long rails and little kickers.

      26 Nov · Feature

      Flakes are here

      Meet Flakes, Freshline's own currency. Earn them on every run (one for every 2,000 points), +25 for a personal best and +100 for the daily challenge. Spend them in the Locker on new premium colours like Gold, Glacier, Lava, Neon and Galaxy. Everyone starts with 250.

      25 Nov · Rider

      A whole new rider

      Your rider got rebuilt from the boots up: real-world proportions, a glossy down puffer with fat baffles and a storm flap, ribbed ankle cuffs, real ski boots with buckles, padded gloves that grip your poles, plus new goggles with a mirrored lens, a proper helmet, knit beanies and a fluffy pom.

      25 Nov · Feature

      First-person mode

      Press V while riding, or pick Camera in the menu, to ride from inside your goggles. Move your mouse to look around, and the view turns with your head through every spin and flip, so corks feel wild. Press V again to jump back to third person.

      24 Nov · Lobby

      A lobby of our own

      Brand-new lobby cards. Your rider card is now a season lift pass with trail markers that light up as you set a best on each park, plus a daily challenge card and a big Drop in button.

      24 Nov · Rider

      Quilted puffers

      Outfits got a full rebuild: boxy quilted puffer jackets with a chest band that runs across the sleeves, a bigger hood, chunky gloves and baggy pants that bunch over your boots. Every Locker colour works with it.

      24 Nov · Snow

      Carved tracks

      Skis now leave two thin grooves in the corduroy and boards leave one wide one. Carve hard and they dig deeper. Fixed a pale flickering strip some graphics cards showed behind the rider.

      24 Nov · Patch

      The big flaw hunt

      17 fixes in one go: no more pyramid mountains at the finish, proper crash tumbles, smoother autoland, a lighter terrain for faster frame rates, and a full pass on phone layouts.

      23 Nov · Parks

      Bigger jumps, wider parks

      Every table grew: longer ramps, bigger decks, longer landings and roughly two seconds of air. Rows are spaced further apart and the trail is now about 100 m wide.

      23 Nov · Feature

      Night mode

      Press N (or open the menu) to switch between day, sunset, blue hour and night. Night brings a moon, stars, more lamps and warm pools of light on the snow.

      23 Nov · Tricks

      New trick animation

      Your hands really reach the skis on grabs, shoulders lead every spin, knees tuck on flips and you open up to stomp the landing. Spins are slower and pop is softer for better control.

      Thanks for riding. More parks, more tricks and more gear are on the way. — the Freshline team

        Settings

        View

        Third person follows behind your rider. First person puts the camera in your goggles: move your mouse to look around. Press V while riding to switch.

        Position
        Lens
        Quality

        Shadows, snow detail and resolution. Lower it if the game stutters.

        Light

        Time of day on the parks.

        View distance

        How far the haze reaches. Lower runs smoother.

        Snowfall

        Light snow drifting past the camera.

        Key hints

        The control strip at the top of the screen while you ride.

        Sound

        Camera, sound and your rider are saved on this device.

        Auto landing

        On: let go of your spin and flip keys near the snow and a nearly finished trick turns round by itself. Off: you land every trick yourself.

        Key bindings

        Click an action, then press the key you want for it. Esc cancels.

        Ghost of your best run

        On the downhill parks, a see-through rider replays your personal best so you can race it. G turns it on or off while riding.

        Keys
        A / D
        Carve on snow, spin in the air. Hold with S for a cork, with W for a bio, or with a roll key for a flatspin.
        W
        Pole and tuck on snow. Frontflip in the air.
        S
        Brake on snow. Backflip in the air.
        ← → / J L
        Roll in the air. Alone it's a sideflip.
        ↓ / K
        Chill: hold it off the lip for a half-speed air.
        Space
        Hold to load, release to pop. A loaded pop spins and flips faster.
        Shift Q E
        Mute, tail and Japan grabs. Hold 0.25 s to count, 1 s for the full bonus.
        B
        Butter: hold B and press A or D on the snow.
        On a rail
        A / D swaps your slide, Space hops. Hold a spin key at the end to spin off.
        R · Esc · H · N
        Restart · menu · hide key hints · change time of day (day, sunset, blue hour, night).
        V
        Switch between third-person and first-person view. In first person, move the mouse to look around.
        Credits

        Freshline is a ZigWork Labs game, built with Claude. 3D graphics run on three.js and every sound is generated live in your browser.

        Scoring
        Difficulty
        2,000 × turns²: 360 = 2,000, 720 = 8,000, 1080 = 18,000. +15% each time you go upside down, ×1.25 off switch.
        Amplitude
        180 a second in the air and 48 a metre of height. Small hops off flat snow don't count.
        Grabs
        Count after 0.25 s. Up to +25% of the rotation (all of it when held 1 s), +5% for each extra grab, plus 1,120 a second and 400 per grab.
        Variety
        Your last 3 tricks are remembered. Repeats pay 70%, 45%, then 30%. Left and right, switch and on/off a rail are different tricks.
        Flow
        A line is everything from leaving the snow to landing on it again. Each extra link (air, rail, air) adds ×0.25.
        Landing
        Stomped (within 17°, over your skis): +600 and 15% of the line. Saved it: 85% down to 50% fully sideways. Crash: the line is gone.
        Rails · butters
        1,000 a second on the bar and 600 per swap or hop. Butters: press 200, 180 = 400, 360 = 800, first 4 of a run.
